verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ramp lets users spin up new virtual/business cards quickly and manage expense tracking, implying some per-card issuance and control, but no direct documentation of granular per-card spend limits, category/merchant restrictions, or per-employee control configuration is present. missing for 10: explicit docs on setting spend limits per card, merchant/category restrictions, per-employee policy controls, and any independent confirmation of these specific controls working as advertised.
